digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync and reconcile command parser
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass, carry arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail into a single manifest, and bypass pass-lock acquisition/purge/release.
Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, and diagnostic JSON artifact unchanged.

Argparse allow_abbrev=False rejects undocumented prefix abbreviations like --dry-run (which currently abbreviates --dry-run-enumerate) with invocation error 2 before repository or lock mutation, while documented options --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync emit identical field-comparable manifest envelopes; canonical uncapped live retains a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, whereas legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain historical tally/no-manifest behavior.
Legacy reconcile-check, legacy --mode live, library/MCP/workflow callers, and external helpers retain their historical observable contracts and output semantics.
